title: Cyberwave Environment Update Notice
description: Tells open viewers that part of an environment changed, so they refetch it. Published by the backend on {prefix}cyberwave/environment/{environment_uuid}/update after the change is committed. changed_fields names the settings sections that changed; the set is closed, so a publisher naming a section nobody listens for is an error rather than a silent no-op. The environment's twin events travel on sibling topics (twin_added, twin_updated, twin_deleted) with their own data and are not covered here. Identified by its topic, not by a field: the payload carries no contract id.

type.description: The message family on the environment topics.

update_type.description: What happened: part of the environment's own data changed.

source_type.description: Who made the change, one of the source_type values. Absent on the navigation and odometry anchor notices, which predate the field; readers treat absence as lenient.

timestamp.description: Seconds since the epoch. No publisher of this notice sends it today.

changed_fields.description: The settings sections that changed. embed: the share embed. navigation: the navigation anchor. odometry_anchors: the twins' odometry anchors. scene_hierarchy: scene groups, ordering and the waypoint collections moved with them.
